question: Which of the following trees are found in the Deciduous forests of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Deciduous forests primarily grow in areas with rainfall between 100 to 200 cm.
 
• They are prevalent in the foothills of the Himalayas, parts of central India, and along the eastern Ghats.
 
• Sal, amla, shisham, and mahua are common species found in these forests.
 
• While there are deciduous forests in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, they are not typically classified as moist deciduous due to the different environmental conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Distribution:

 
 
• Moist deciduous forests are also found in Orissa and along the foothills of the Western Ghats.
 
 
 
• Ecological Importance:
 
 
• These forests play a critical role in maintaining the ecological balance, supporting diverse wildlife, and aiding in the regulation of the climate.
 
 
 
• Conservation Efforts:
 
 
• Efforts are ongoing to preserve these forests, which face threats from logging and land conversion for agriculture and development.
